purpose: The spec sections the reference implementation used and the rebuild retired (docs/retired.md). The parser refuses each by name and says what replaced it. Kept as data, like the glossary's rejected names, so the refused names appear nowhere in code or prose.

sections.replacement: ## invariants: a claim with enforcement becomes one invariant bullet (protects/chokepoint or over/via); exists and imports claims are dropped
because: lines on the invariants the prose explains; rationale that restates a mechanism is dropped
## trust levels in the entry spec: one bullet per level, name: meaning
refuted: <what was broken> -> <what was seen> (YYYY-MM-DD) on the invariant it witnessed
nothing: reliance is computed from references, never declared
nothing: reliance is computed from references, never declared
the one-line intent, and because: lines on the invariants that carry the design
